news_articles.title: Influential Women distinguishes Arpita Dacy as a Principal Technical Program Manager at Autodesk, driving AI innovation.

news_articles.title: Aligning vision, advancing innovation: SKETS Studio and Autodesk sign strategic MoU.

news_articles.title: Autodesk commits $350 million to prepare the next generation for the AI jobs that design and make the physical world.
news_articles.snippet: That work extends globally, including in India, one of the world's largest talent markets, where Autodesk is helping bring these digital skills to more than 14,500 Industrial Training Institutes (ITIs) and 33 National Skill Training Institutes (NSTIs), while partnering with employers like NAMTECH and ArcelorMittal Nippon Steel on curriculum, faculty training, and certification pathways aligned to India's industry needs.
